SINGLE-HORIZON VIEW: everything on this screen is the latest prediction for the selected year only — past runs are never stacked or shown. Three pathways at that horizon: green = saved & secured by your allocation; ink = still exposed. WORST = fuel keeps accumulating (no sustained program) × warming trend · AVERAGE = partial program · BEST = sustained program. Evidence scars keep fading on the map by the same 15-yr rule; no invented future fires are drawn. You don't choose the climate — you choose the fuel.

PROVENANCE: mixed, declared per element. REAL: the 25 fire rings (documented events 1979–2026 — place & week real, hectares approximate from EFFIS/press/EGIF; Burgohondo Jul 2026 = largest in the Spanish record) · Spain's burnable universe: 28.4M ha wildland of 50.6M ha territory (MITECO) · EGIF record 1968–2023: 641,751 fires / 8.18M ha cumulative — of which, per southern-Europe Landsat mapping, ~30% of burned land burned ≥2× (mean re-burn gap 13.3 yrs — the basis of this sim's 15-yr scar fade & 5-yr regrowth) · economics calibration (≈47.8M people, ~€1.5T GDP, capital ≈€200k/person — OWID/World Bank) · year severities anchored on AEMET-reported patterns · century fuel curve anchored on IFN/afforestation history. REAL PER-CELL (GrootGuard pipeline, teammate build): 14,002 H3 res-6 cells → 2,117 res-5 aggregates — fuel fractions (ESA WorldCover 2021), population & WUI-exposed population (Kontur), assets in 6 classes with names (OSM), municipality names, real geometry. STILL MODEL: weather, moisture, fire-history priors, Natura overlap, rankings and forecasts — per the pipeline's own provenance (weather/priority deliberately excluded there). No-data renders dark, never green.
